about: Walkthrough queue: web sites in the refero.design catalog with no systems/ package. One measured package per domain; styles are landing-page design only and never substitute.
method: extract-style skill + tools/kit/ (docs/CAPTURE.md), then the systems/<slug>/ layout in docs/PACKAGE.md with evidence labels and a catalog.json entry in the same change.
agent_notes: Dismiss popups and consent dialogs yourself: cookie banners (allow/disallow), OneTrust/Cookiebot prompts, newsletter modals, app-install banners, region pickers. Never hand a dismissable popup back to the user.

Sign-in is the owner's, not the agent's: when a flow needs an authenticated account (Google OAuth, email signup), pause and hand the browser to the owner to sign in, then continue. Never create accounts or complete OAuth yourself.

Escalate only real blockers: CAPTCHA loops, phone/SMS verification, payment walls, org SSO or invite gates, hardware keys. Set status to "blocked" with the reason in notes instead of deferring silently.

Capture functionality, not just design: walk onboarding and the core flows (first run, main screens, settings, key actions). The refero style for the same domain is landing-page design only; do not reuse it as app evidence.
One app per PR: when it merges set status to "captured" and package to the systems/<slug>. Keep this manifest in the commit.

login-extracted tracks the signed-in pass. Leave it not-started until that pass starts. Set partial with the stop reason in notes, or done only after login-review names every screen the signed-in navigation offered. A review of the first page is not done.

login-probe records whether an email code can sign in. Leave it not-tried until the probe runs. Set code-sent, signed-in, password, oauth-only, captcha, phone, closed, or no-form, and write the URL and the page result in notes. The probe does not open the product.
